**Roles and Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, write, and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for complex web and mobile applications.

**Requirements** 




  




* Experience 2\-3 Years

 Strong knowledge of SQL for writing queries, joins, and backend validation.

**Job Description**
 Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. The Reviewer is responsible for analyzing transactions and identifying risks/gaps including determining differences and/or inconsistencies, across various products and global regions.

 IRIS RegTech Solutions Limited (formerly IRIS Business Services Limited) is India’s only listed RegTech SaaS provider, pioneering technology\-driven regulatory and supervisory compliance solutions worldwide. Headquartered in Mumbai with subsidiaries across the U.S., Singapore, Malaysia, and Italy, IRIS serves over 30 regulators and 6,500 enterprises in 55 countries. Recognized globally for its award\-winning SupTech, RegTech, and DataTech platforms \- including IRIS iFile, IRIS iDEAL®, IRIS CARBON®, and IRIS MSME \- IRIS helps banking and financial sector regulators digitize supervision and enterprises and achieve seamless financial and ESG reporting.
   

  

 IRIS’ products are XII certified, ISO 27001:13 and SSAE 18 (SOC 1 Type 2\) certified, ensuring industry leading security and reliability. Combined with deep expertise in XBRL, AI, and ML, IRIS delivers robust, high\-quality regulatory data infrastructure that enhances transparency, strengthens governance, and supports sustainable growth across the financial ecosystem.

title: Validation Engineer
description:
Seeking a Validation Engineer (2–4 years exp) in Mechanical, Electronics, or Mechatronics to lead motor and gearbox performance testing, build test setups, and execute DVP\&R validation plans.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join our engineering team as a Validation Engineer to drive performance, reliability, and quality across our advanced motor and gearbox product lines. In this hands\-on role, you will bridge R\&D and production by specifying dynamometers and test setups, executing end\-to\-end validation protocols (torque\-speed mapping, efficiency, thermal rise, backlash, and noise/vibration), and conducting root\-cause failure investigations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work closely with Design/R\&D, Manufacturing, Quality, and Reliability teams.
* Provide feedback to design engineers on improvements for design\-for\-testability and design\-for\-reliability.
* Collaborate with design/R\&D teams to implement corrective actions.
* Design or specify test benches/dynamometers for motor performance testing (torque\-speed curves, efficiency mapping, back\-EMF, cogging torque).
* Motor testing: torque\-speed characteristics, efficiency, current draw, commutation accuracy (for BLDC/stepper), synchronous behavior, thermal rise, back\-EMF waveform, cogging/ripple torque.
* Investigate test failures (e.g., bearing failures, winding insulation breakdown, gear tooth pitting/wear, demagnetization).
* Plan validation across product lifecycle stages: component, sub\-system, and full assembly levels.
* Gearbox testing: efficiency, backlash, noise/vibration, lubrication effectiveness, gear tooth wear, thermal performance.
* Prepare validation test reports, DVP\&R sign\-off documents, and engineering change validation records.
* Support certification processes (EMI/EMC testing, safety testing).
* Maintain test data traceability and validation history for audits (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 if automotive\-adjacent).
* Define pass/fail criteria based on design specs, customer requirements, and standards (IEC 60034, NEMA, ISO, AGMA for gears, etc.).
* Continuously update technical knowledge and stay current with industry trends, design practices, and software tools.
* Participate in internal training sessions and support knowledge sharing within the team.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
 Experience: 2 \- 4 years
   

  

 Qualification: B.E. / Diploma in Mechanical / Electronics / Mechtronics

title: Senior Consultant - Quality Assurance
description:
**Job Description**
 WSP is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Lead to establish and lead practical QA practices for our Digital Environment development team. This hands\-on role will define quality strategy, improve delivery processes, guide testing activities, and promote shared ownership of quality across the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 The team delivers data management, software development, and web\-based weather information services for internal and external clients using cloud technologies and Agile delivery practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Quality Strategy, Governance \& Process Leadership
   

  

* Define and implement a practical QA strategy, operating model, standards, roadmap, and supporting templates.
* Assess current practices, identify quality risks and process gaps, and prioritize measurable improvements.
* Establish quality gates, release\-readiness practices, defect workflows, and test evidence expectations.


 Test Planning, Automation \& Execution
   

  

* Lead risk\-based test planning for features, integrations, data workflows, and production releases.
* Perform and oversee manual and automated testing across web, API, data\-processing, and mobile solutions.
* Develop and maintain the team’s test automation approach, including standards and CI/CD integration.
* Track defects and quality risks, support timely resolution, and turn findings into process improvements.


 Team Leadership \& Capability Development
   

  

* Provide technical direction, mentoring, and coordination for QA professionals and others performing testing.
* Help shape QA roles, responsibilities, recruitment, onboarding, and future team structure.


 Collaboration \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Participate in Agile planning, refinement, stand\-ups, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Provide evidence\-based recommendations on product quality, release readiness, and material risks.
* Promote shared ownership of quality rather than treating QA as a final testing step.


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of software QA experience, including senior, lead, or equivalent responsibilities.
* Experience defining and improving QA processes, standards, governance, measures, and team practices.
* Experience leading or mentoring QA professionals; formal supervisory experience is an asset.
* Strong knowledge of testing methods, risk\-based testing, defect management, root\-cause analysis, and quality engineering.
* Hands\-on test automation experience using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Experience testing web applications, APIs, integrations, data\-processing workflows, and CI/CD quality controls.
* Strong analytical, facilitation, and communication, and skills.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience**
* Experience with cloud services, especially Amazon Web Services, and 24/7 operational systems.
* Experience with performance, reliability, accessibility, security, mobile, or usability testing.
* Experience testing data\-intensive, geospatial, environmental, weather, or other operationally critical systems.
